ProofCheck/How it works
THE PROOFCHECK METHOD

Evidence gets a record, not a halo.

ProofCheck does one focused job in the MVP: evaluate public claims about whether a GitHub repository is open source.

THE SHORT VERSION

From statement to onchain result.

ProofCheck keeps the user flow simple while GenLayer handles the evidence review in the background.

01

Send a claim

Connect a wallet, write one statement, and add public evidence links.

02

Sign free testnet submission

ProofCheck verification costs 0 GEN in Studio; the wallet may show a separate protocol fee.

03

GenLayer verifies

The Intelligent Contract reads the links; validators analyze and compare the evidence.

04

Open Claim detail

After FINALIZED execution, the page shows the claim, wallet, verdict, reason, hash, time, and transaction reference.

RESULTS / THREE POSSIBLE OUTCOMES

Clear results, no permanent badges.

EVIDENCE AT REVIEW TIME

Supported

The evidence supports the claim at the time of review.

Clear supporting evidence.

Insufficient

The evidence is missing, unclear, or not specific enough.

More information is needed.

Refuted

The evidence directly conflicts with the claim.

Contradicting evidence found.
CHALLENGE A RESULT

Send opposing evidence.

Add a public source and explain what should be revisited. The current form prepares the rebuttal; when the onchain write is enabled, GenLayer will create a new review and keep the original history visible.
